text:
Anita: Heads-up: pen-test window Wed 2024-03-27 09:00-13:00 UTC — need final ops checklist. We'll hand over det-logs, RBAC snapshots, KMS presigned creds. Who's owning evidence packaging?

Sam: I can own evidence packaging. Need list of artifacts + presigned S3 path. ETA today EOD?

Kevin: For RBAC, we should snapshot current policies and include explicit role bindings. I'll run a quick query:

Kevin: `kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o yaml > rbac-snapshot.yaml`

Lina: Need audit log export for SIEM: newline-delimited JSON with fields: requestUser, resource, verb, timestamp, k8s.requestURI, kms.key_id. Retention: staging 30d. Make sure decryption events are preserved.

Anita: @Kevin add ephemeral-role timeline: start/stop times + who to swap in. Mention cross-account KMS proxy creds.

OpsBot: pen-test-scheduler: slot confirmed 2024-03-27T09:00Z — presigned-upload-url expires in 72h.

Sam: sample upload instructions:

Sam: ```
curl -X PUT "https://presigned.example.com/abcd" -T evidence.tar.gz \
  -H "Content-Type: application/gzip"
```

Kevin: KMS question — will assessors need DECRYPT on eq-key or will we proxy decrypt via service? If giving decrypt perms, we must rotate keys and enable key-access audit trails. I prefer proxy and explicit decrypt endpoints.

Lina: +1 proxy. Also enable CloudTrail KMS logs + tag key usage. Add detection: if KMS:Decrypt by non-proxy account -> alert.

Anita: For RBAC change windows: create a one-hour maintenance window after test for rollback. Put change plan in PR: ops/pt-rbac-rollback.md :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll create the PR and include artifact checklist: rbac-snapshot.yaml, audit-export.ndjson, evidence-manifest.json, presigned links, kms-access-matrix.json.

Kevin: For retest: propose 2-week remediation window with 3 retest slots. We'll coordinate here. Any blockers?

OpsBot: evidence-uploader-bot: presigned link created -> https://presigned.example.com/abcd (expires 72h)

Lina: Quick question: can we mask user ids in exported logs? Assessors need traceability but PII must be redacted. Suggest separate mapping file encrypted with KMS and uploaded.

Anita: Good call. Include pseudonym mapping encrypted with KMS:Encrypt. Key id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234

Sam: Will upload mapping.enc to presigned path. ETA EOD.

Kevin: I'll run a dry-run of the handoff automation today. Command I'll use: `./tools/pt-handoff --snapshot rbac-snapshot.yaml --upload-url \"https://presigned.example.com/abcd\"`

Anita: Thanks team. I'll compile the handoff doc (ops/pt-handoff.md) and ping Legal for NDA confirmation. Reconvene 14:00 for final sign-off. :raised_hands:
